title: A Bayesian par for Test blocks
blurb: The session-block par refitted as a multilevel count model in Stan: held-out error and posterior predictive checks against the ridge and cell pars, where the variation lives, and carry once an innings effect is pooled.

title: Should the ratings allow for the conditions of the day?
blurb: A pre-registered test of adding a per-match conditions effect to the player ratings: does crediting runs relative to how everyone else scored that day predict matches better, and how much do the rankings move?

title: Cricket rankings and predictions
blurb: Tests, T20Is and ODIs on one page: team and player rankings, upcoming matches, matchup scenarios, player value and model validation, with men's and women's coverage.

title: Can Duckworth–Lewis be improved?
blurb: A resource table fitted to each format and sex against the official Standard Edition, and whether the targets actually set in rain-affected chases have favoured one side.

title: Does form carry over between cricket formats?
blurb: A pre-registered test of whether a player's recent form in T20 predicts their next one-day match (and the reverse) beyond their own history in that format, batting and bowling, men and women.

title: Is there a hot hand in cricket?
blurb: A pre-registered test at two time scales: do recent innings predict the next beyond a player's level, and within an innings is the ball after a boundary (or a wicket) better than the player's average ball?

title: Ideas for experiments
blurb: Questions worth testing, by sport, with links to the write-ups as each is done.

title: NBA 2026–27 season outlook
blurb: Win totals, offence and defence ranks, seeding odds and games-played forecasts for every team, against the Kalshi win-total markets; luck and player WAR.

title: Test innings, session by session: above or below expectation?
blurb: A par for every 30-over block of a Test innings from the match state and the two sides, recent Tests scored block by block, and whether a block above par predicts the next.

title: Upcoming predictions
blurb: Every upcoming forecast on one page: NBA, NFL, rugby league and cricket games beside the Kalshi and Polymarket prices, the Victorian election and the NBA season, with recent results.

title: Victorian election 2026: seat-by-seat forecast
blurb: All 88 Legislative Assembly seats for 28 November 2026: maps, win probabilities, seat counts, the Kalshi markets and how the model did in 2018 and 2022.

title: Wickets in hand: a Bayesian par for wickets
blurb: The hazard-binomial wickets model registered and its beta-binomial expansion tested against the cell mean under a rule fixed in advance, on the same held-out years as the Bayesian-par note (development evidence).
